text_block_list.text:
One evening, while shopping for
fishing tackle with Cheval Grand—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Um... I'm sorry.
For dragging you along on my shopping trip...
choice_data_list: Because I wanted to learn more about fishing too.
Because I wanted to learn more about fishing too

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I-Is that so.
...So that's how it is...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...U-Um, if you really don't need it,
please don't hesitate to say so..."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
W-Would you like to borrow a fishing DVD...?
It's my personal recommendation...
(Bzz, bzz)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, I-I'm sorry!
Please excuse me for a moment...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"A LANE message... from Dad.
He says he's 'sharing some good luck'..."
Cheval Grand shows her smartphone screen. Displayed there was a magnificent flounder.
choice_data_list: Your dad caught this? That's amazing!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"Really...?! What a huge catch...!
It's easily over 40 cm."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Starting the New Year off with good fortune, huh...
Looks like Dad's in peak condition this year too.
(Clang, clang!)

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle is underway~!
The grand prize is an all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
2nd prize is "Mountain of Carrots"!
3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the fun, fun lottery!
Anyone and everyone, come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it...
we got a lottery ticket from shopping earlier, didn't we?"
choice_data_list: Why not catch a big one with that and show your dad?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Huh, from the raffle...?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Um... will I win, I wonder?
I'm... not really the lucky type...
choice_data_list: Fishing and raffles are the same — you never know what you'll get until you reel it in!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: You never know until you draw.........

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
......Yeah.
...You're right... aren't you...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Well then...
I'll give it a try...

Cheval Grand took a deep breath
and turned the handle of the lottery machine!
And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!!
The Grand Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been won~~~~!!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Huh...? N-No way...?!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I can't believe... I actually won...
choice_data_list: Congratulations, Cheval!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ah, thank you very much...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Um... I'll send a photo of the tickets
to Dad... But what should I do with the real ones?)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Holding onto it is just a waste on me, and besides,
it's not like I have anyone to invite...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Um...
Do you want this, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Well... hot springs are meant to be a place to take things slow, after all...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Um, maybe invite someone... someone you feel relaxed around...
choice_data_list: It's a big catch, so we've got to treasure it.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Huh... But...
choice_data_list: Why don't you invite someone you can relax around instead?
Why don't you invite someone you can feel relaxed around instead?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: S-Someone who can make me feel at ease...?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (I-If that's the case... then for me—)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Still, that's just what I'm thinking...
Inviting them might just end up being a bother...)

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Little lady, don't hold back, go right ahead.
These hot springs have amazing healing properties—you'll feel totally refreshed, ya know~?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Soothing...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Trainer probably needs that...
Being with someone like me all the time must be exhausting.)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Then...
This ticket really is...!)

Putting the hot springs ticket on hold for now,
we head back to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(...I-I have to say it.
I have to invite them...!)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(To a hot spring... on a retreat,
w-would you like to go with me...?!)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: *Inhale*... *exhale*... ......

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ah... Um, Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I-Is it, a—
choice_data_list: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
B... Barred knifejaw's
season is in spring and autumn...!!
choice_data_list: ...Oh, is that so!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (I... I'm such an idioooot~~...!!)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(This time for sure, I'm going to say it...!
Without dodging the topic like before...!)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
U-Um...! Excuse me,
do you have a moment...?
choice_data_list: What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Um, w-with me...! W-Wo-Would...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: On a retreat—

text_block_list.name: Passing Roasted Sweet Potato Vendor
text_block_list.text: Stone-baked sweet potaaatoeees~♪

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (!? It overlapped...!!)
choice_data_list: Ah, do you want to eat baked sweet potato?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ah... umm...!
I-It's fine...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ......I want to eat baked sweet potatoes...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Jeez, what's wrong with me...?
Why am I like this...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Nothing will start unless I say something...
I know that, and yet...)
choice_data_list: ...Are you already tired today?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Why is that...?
choice_data_list: Because you looked a little down.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(What am I doing...?
It wasn't supposed to be like this...
Making Trainer worry needlessly...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(That's not it!
That's... not how it is, damn it...!!)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
......Trainer-san!
Um......!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"W-Won't you come with me!?
Together! To the hot springs...!!"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I... I want to thank you.
For always taking such good care of me...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Um... I'm still busy right now, but...
if I ever manage to accomplish something great...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Maybe as a way to unwind then...!
W-What do you think...!?

Cheval Grand's earnest expression...
I thought something was off about her, but was this
what she wanted to say all along?
Seeing her like that, emotions welled up inside me—
choice_data_list: I'm glad, Cheval.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Trainer...
choice_data_list: Let's go to the hot springs together!

text_block_list.text:
Once the race schedule winds down, we'll definitely go.
The two of them made that promise together.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~!
The prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: First prize...! I did it...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
As for sending photos to Dad,
I'll do that after getting back...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
This might be... a bit too big
for one person to eat alone...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Um... Trainer-san.
Could you help me out...?

We savored our hamburg steaks together.
Supervised by a long-established, renowned restaurant,
it was quite delicious.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I know this shop... My dad and everyone
used to bring me here all the time when I was a kid.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: "I always used to order off the kid's menu... With big sister, and with Vivlos..."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, Vivlos used to
collect the little flags stuck in carrots...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Big sis even went to the drink bar
to get drinks for all of us...
choice_data_list: How was Cheval doing?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Um, I was... quietly eating.
Hamburg steak...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...I just... got carried away...

As we ate hamburg steak,
I listened to her reminisce about the past.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!!
The prize is a "Mountain of Carrots"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: S-So much...?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
When I told Dad about it,
he ended up worrying about me instead...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Even I'm wondering if I can actually burn all of this off...
choice_data_list: In that case, why not cook it to show them?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I think that's... a good idea.
However, I'm... not very good at cooking...
choice_data_list: I'll teach you, so wanna try making it together?
I'll teach you, so want to try making it together?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Together with Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. That way, it'll be a better learning experience.
Besides, if there are two of us, maybe we can finish it...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...C-Could I ask you for a favor...?
Afterward, Cheval Grand cooked carrot dishes using the recipes she had learned.
The result was only so-so, but her father praised her upon seeing the photograph.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
3rd prize~!
The prize is "one carrot"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: This is...
choice_data_list: One carrot...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"I'm... not a big shot worth reporting about,
right...?"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
…………Ah.
But, the other day in a book……

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Huh, Cheval, you're fishing too?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ah... yes. I was thinking of trying out
some fishing bait made from carrots...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ho-hoh, now that is intriguing.
Let's see what you've got~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oh! What a massive tug!
Could this be...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Sky-san...!
Could... could you grab the landing net, please...?!
(SPLAAASH!!)

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
—Whoa, look at the big fish!
—I-I did it...!
After that, Cheval Grand went to report the big catch she made with a carrot to her father.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost!
Your consolation prize is a pack of tissues~
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Tissues...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ugh...
I really wanted to win *something*...

Cheval Grand slumped her shoulders
in deep dejection.
